snippet.title: The Amazon Translation Team in Luxembourg
snippet.description:
The Amazon Translation Team is hiring! Meet the team and discover our roles in translation, proofreading, post-editing and outsourcing.

We achieve the impossible by making millions of products available to customers all around the globe.

Our core mission is to help customers make a purchasing decision by offering them all relevant information about a product in their preferred language and by ensuring that human and machine-generated translations meet the right level of quality.

We are currently based in Luxembourg, Singapore and Costa Rica, and continue to grow rapidly. Our multicultural team is made up of highly skilled language professionals, among them Translators, Proofreaders and Outsourcing Specialists, who contribute to the expansion of the product selection on our international platforms. Whether your background is in translation, modern languages, communication or any other related field, we offer diverse job profiles that allow you to translate, post-edit, work on quality assessment and collaborate with machine learning teams, as well as acquire program management skills. Come join us and make an impact on our customers all around the globe with every word you edit. 

Learn more: https://www.amazon.jobs/en/teams/translation-team

snippet.title: Amazon Legal Team talks about working at Amazon
snippet.description:
Our legal team is deeply involved in every aspect of Amazon’s diverse set of businesses and operations, from exploring ground-breaking new products and services to bringing our best ideas to market and operating effectively at global scale. We are integral members of Amazon teams disrupting established ways of doing business for the benefit of our customers – whether it’s reading books on a device (Kindle), providing just about anything you need fast (Amazon.com; PrimeNow), establishing the cloud as the place to do business (AWS), delivering packages by drone (PrimeAir), launching new TV shows (Golden Globe-winning Transparent and Mozart in the Jungle for Best Television Series—Musical or Comedy) and many others. The scope of our work is truly incredible.

To keep up with Amazon’s growing list of exciting business opportunities, we are looking for outstanding legal professionals who thrive on big challenges, think creatively and analytically to solve hard problems, and consistently deliver great results despite the odds.  We want people who are excited about working with innovative and disruptive businesses to deliver incredible customer experiences.
